QuestInfo.name: Cutter's Concerns
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1095003##k is just getting you in trouble. Why don't you see how #b#p1096006##k is doing with that energy you brought him?
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1096006##k says you should just ignore #b#p1096006##k, and make yourself useful instead. He wants you to check on #b#p1092013##k, who was looking for help earlier. #b#p1092013##k is on #r#m120030100##k.

0.0: Oy, you need to stop doing those stupid errands #b#p1095003##k gives you. She's just a jealous mess right now. Give her time to think about her mischief.\r\n
0.1: Look, you don't have time to dilly-dally around here! We're responsible for the safety of the Nautilus and the nearby towns.\r\n
0.2: I'm getting reports that Florina Beach is getting overrun with Clangs and Lorangs. I know you've already had some run-ins with Lorangs, so I think you'd be perfect for this next mission.

yes.0: Great. Go see #b#p1092013##k in #r#m120030100##k, and help the citizens with their burdens. Piracy isn't all looting and pillaging, you know.

no.0: Your duty is to keep the common people safe. You're not going to do that sitting around like a lump.

1.0: Is Florina Beach doomed...? Then where will people surf?

yes.0: The Lorangs and Clangs are starting to endanger the people of Florina Beach. Third-degree pinchings are at an all-time high.
